why_graph_induction_is_essential.fact: An n-crossing rigid graph with nu vertices can be turned into a link with n+5nu crossings by the displayed fixed tangle insertions; a link flype factorization then leaves those tangle interiors intact.
why_graph_induction_is_essential.warning: This observation does not let an n-crossing graph step follow from link induction only through n crossings: it would require larger n+5nu link cases. The actual proof therefore enlarges the induction category to ALL rigid graphs from the outset.
